图片内文字：
- Overview of Key Global Trials
- A complete list of Clinical Trials can be found in Appendix 1 of the CTSA at the end of the document

表格表头：
- Study
- Indication
- Description
- Transfer Trial Operation
- Planned start of operational transfer

表格内容（逐行，“表头：值”）：
1)  
- Study：1368-0025  
- Indication：GPP  
- Description：Ph II - 5 Year Open label extension study (EFFISAYIL ON)  
- Transfer Trial Operation：After MA and Sponsor* Transfer  
- Planned start of operational transfer：Q1-2026  

2)  
- Study：1368-0120  
- Indication：GPP  
- Description：Ph IV - Post Marketing Study (EFFISAYIL REP)  
- Transfer Trial Operation：Completion to Final CTR  
- Planned start of operational transfer：N/A  

3)  
- Study：1368-0093  
- Indication：GPP  
- Description：Ph IV - Post-marketing surveillance of Spesolimab I.V. - Japan (local)  
- Transfer Trial Operation：After MA transfer  
- Planned start of operational transfer：tbd  

4)  
- Study：1368-0122  
- Indication：GPP  
- Description：Ph IV - Safety and effectiveness of Spesolimab - Korea (local)  
- Transfer Trial Operation：Transfer around effective date  
- Planned start of operational transfer：Effective date  

5)  
- Study：1368-0128  
- Indication：GPP  
- Description：A 5-Year Active Surveillance, Post-Authorisation Safety Study to Characterize the Safety of Spesolimab for Use in Patients with GPP  
- Transfer Trial Operation：After MA and Sponsor* Transfer  
- Planned start of operational transfer：Q1-2026  

6)  
- Study：1368-0140  
- Indication：PG  
- Description：Ph III - Pivotal Trial for PG MAA  
- Transfer Trial Operation：Completion to Final DBL  
- Planned start of operational transfer：N/A  

7)  
- Study：1368-XXXX  
- Indication：PG  
- Description：Pediatric program in PG  
- Transfer Trial Operation：To be fully conducted by partner  
- Planned start of operational transfer：-  

8)  
- Study：1368-0098  
- Indication：HS  
- Description：Ph IIb - DRF study in HS  
- Transfer Trial Operation：No transfer – close out and CTR as planned  
- Planned start of operational transfer：-  

9)  
- Study：1368-0100  
- Indication：HS  
- Description：HS OLE study  
- Transfer Trial Operation：No transfer – close out and CTR as planned  
- Planned start of operational transfer：-  

10)  
- Study：1368-0104  
- Indication：NS  
- Description：Ph III trial in NS adults and adolescents  
- Transfer Trial Operation：No transfer – close out and CTR as planned  
- Planned start of operational transfer：-  

脚注/注释文字：
- *Transfer of Sponsorship to be determined based on MA transfer status, region (US vs ROW) and in agreement with Partner
- Green denotes ongoing trials to be conducted by Boehringer to completion
- MA= Marketing Authorization, CTR= Clinical Trial Report
- Boehringer Ingelheim
- Privileged and Confidential. For internal use only
- 53

视觉关系：
- 这是一个表格，按列展示：Study/Indication/Description/Transfer Trial Operation/Planned start of operational transfer 的对应关系。
- 颜色编码：绿色（行内或字段背景为绿色）表示“ongoing trials to be conducted by Boehringer to completion”（对应注释说明）。
- 红色矩形框强调了部分行：包括 Study 为 1368-0025、1368-0120 的两行，以及 Study 为 1368-0140 的一行（被单独框出）。
